The licence does not grant trademark rights, except the limited uses described in section 6. Reusing the materials does not imply OEMS endorsement or certification. Public conformance-claim rules remain to be defined.

OEMS remains an unreleased working draft. Selecting an open licence does not establish a stable release, certification programme or standards-body recognition.
